And as their communication skills continue to develop, they enjoy imitating animal sounds as well. st: Discovering Shapes: Circles, Squares, and More
d: As babies develop, their understanding of the world, and how its pieces "fit" together, continues to progress. DISCOVERING SHAPES playfully introduces five basic forms circle, oval, triangle, square and rectangle as each appears in the context of toys, nature and everyday objects.
